description: Create a contact, or update the existing one with the same phone_number.

fields.description: Up to 20 string values (account id, plan, location...), usable in segments and as {{field:key}} merge fields

name.description: Display name. Defaults to first + last name.

opt_in.description: Import only (POST /v1/contacts/import). Stored as consent evidence; never lifts an opt-out.

at.description: When they opted in: ISO timestamp, date, or epoch ms

campaign_id.description: The registration the opt-in is for. A marketing or mixed registration needs at, a recognised source, and page_url for a web form, or the row is skipped

page_url.description: The page a web-form opt-in was collected on

source.description: web_form, keyword, paper, checkout or verbal are stored as proof; anything else is kept as a note

status.description: true = opted in; false = unsubscribed (recorded as an opt-out)

source.description: Where the contact came from. Defaults to "api".

state.description: US state or Canadian province, usually a 2-letter code

name: upsert_contact
title: Upsert contact
